content: ugh, says doesn't matter which cable but I'm sure there will be a step later where one is slightly better than the other...
Please make the cable that goes from sensor to sensor longer. I cannot place the OneTop from printables on this machine because the cable is interfering.

If you've removed your right side window, DO NOT REATTACH IT YET. Do section 5, step 13 first: https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/5-spoolholders-tool-dock-assembly_1096255#1104377

It's much easier to do the cable routing while the window is off.

replies.content: Thanks for the tip. I also then proceeded to chapter 5, step 59 for actually installing the dock fan to ensure I had enough slack in the dock fan cable. https://help.prusa3d.com/guide/5-spoolholders-tool-dock-assembly_1096255#1107223
